PANEL_MODULE_SETTINGS_PLACEHOLDER: No module-specific options for this panel type yet.
SETTINGS_INTRO_GENERAL: Language, display, start with Windows, updates, backups and where OpenCue keeps its data.
SETTINGS_INTRO_APPEARANCE: Colours and look of the program and of newly created panels.
SETTINGS_INTRO_DMX: Where the light signal goes: Art-Net, sACN and USB DMX.
SETTINGS_INTRO_REMOTE: Tablets and other computers in the network.
SETTINGS_INTRO_API: Let other programs read and control OpenCue with tokens.
PANEL_DESC_ASSISTANT: Chat with a language model that runs on your own computer (Ollama). Chats are saved as files.
PANEL_DESC_CHAT: Chat with the other connected devices (console, iPad ...) and keep notes and checklists. Everything is saved on the server.
CHP_START: Start a chat with the other devices or write a note.
CHP_EMPTY_CHAT: No messages yet. Write the first one.
CHP_NAME_HINT: Shown next to your messages on all devices. Click to change.
CHP_DELETE_THREAD_BODY: "{name}" and everything in it will be deleted on all devices. This cannot be undone.
CHP_DELETE_MSG_BODY: The message will be deleted on all devices.
CHP_CHANGED_BY: {name} edited this note at the same time - the last save wins.
CHP_NOTE_EMPTY: This note is empty. Click Edit and start writing - or use the buttons for lists and checkboxes.
CHP_T_HEADING: Heading (click again for a smaller one)
SETTINGS_INTRO_VOICE: Say the wake word and right after it a command (English, e.g. "OpenCue, blackout on") - everything stays on this computer, only the voice model is downloaded once, then no internet is needed. On/off: microphone symbol at the top right.
VOICE_ENABLE_HINT: Listens for the wake word with its own microphone. Off by default.
VOICE_DEVICE_HINT: Its own choice - independent of the audio analysis.
VOICE_WORD_HINT_OFF: Spoken in English. Every word must be known to the English speech model.
VOICE_WORD_UNKNOWN: The English speech model does not know: {words}. Choose other words.
VOICE_ERR_APPLY: The voice control could not be started (see the log).
VOICE_SENSITIVITY_HINT: Higher = the wake word has to be heard steadily for a shorter time (right: how long). Reacts more easily, but also more often by mistake.
VOICE_LAST_WAKE: Wake word at {at}: "{phrase}" (heard steadily for {s} s)
VOICE_TEST_HINT: Does the same as the spoken wake word: then say the command.
VOICE_TIP: Voice control: say "{word}" or click here
VOICE_SAVE_FAILED: The voice settings could not be saved.
VOICE_ERR_VOSK: The speech package "vosk" is not installed (pip install -r requirements.txt).
VOICE_ERR_WORD: The wake word contains words the English speech model does not know.
VOICE_ERR_OPEN: The microphone could not be opened (in use or blocked?).
SETTINGS_INTRO_AI: Chat with a language model that runs on your own computer (Ollama) - nothing is sent anywhere else.
AI_DEFAULT_MODE_HINT: A new chat starts like this. The mode can be switched in the chat at any time.
AI_ENABLE_HINT: Off until you switch it on. OpenCue only talks to the server below.
AI_KEY_SET: (a key is saved - type a new one to replace it)
AI_KEY_HINT: Only needed if a proxy in front of Ollama asks for one.
AI_NO_MODELS: The server has no models yet. Install one with: ollama pull <name>
AI_MODEL_HINT: New chats start with this; you can switch it in the chat.
AI_RECOMMENDED_BODY: Context size, temperature, longest answer, waiting time, chat names and the function list go back to the recommended values. Server address, model and permissions stay as they are.
AI_RECOMMENDED_DONE: The recommended values are set - press Save to apply.
AI_RECOMMENDED_HINT: Resets context, temperature, answer length, waiting time, chat names and function list. Address, model and permissions stay.
AI_NUM_CTX_HINT: How much the model reads at once.
AI_NUM_PREDICT_HINT: Longest answer; the model stops after this.
AI_AUTO_TITLE_HINT: The AI names a chat itself. Names you gave stay.
AI_TIMEOUT_HINT: How long OpenCue waits for an answer.
AIP_MODE_GUIDE_DESC: Shows you where something is in the program.
AIP_MODE_WORK_DESC: The AI works with functions: calculate, read the show ...
AIP_MODE_NOT_READY: This mode is still being built - until then the AI answers as in chat mode.
AIP_ASK: The assistant wants to run this function. Allow it?
AIP_ALLOW_ALWAYS_TIP: This function runs without asking from now on. You can undo it in Settings -> AI assistant -> Permissions.
AIP_SLASH_HELP: Lists all functions and how to call them
AIP_UI_MISSING: This is not available here (it may be hidden on this device).
AIP_SAVED_ALWAYS: Saved: "{name}" now runs without asking. Undo it in Settings -> AI assistant -> Permissions.
AIP_LIMIT_REPEAT: The AI kept calling the same function with the same values - it was stopped and answers with what it has.
AIP_LIMIT_MAX: That was a lot of function calls for one question - the AI was stopped and answers with what it has.
AIP_TOOLS_TOO_BIG: All functions at once do not fit into the context window of this model - the common functions plus collection functions are used instead (Settings -> AI assistant -> Work mode -> Function list).
AI_TOOLS_CORE: Common ones at once, the rest on demand (recommended)
AI_TOOLS_MODE_HINT: Short prompt: the AI loads rare functions only when it needs them. Good for small models.
AI_PERM_CRITICAL_HINT: Far-reaching, e.g. command line, deleting, loading a show.
AI_ALLOWED_HINT: Confirmed with "Always allow" in the chat. Remove one and it asks again.
AIP_WELCOME_TEXT: Write a message below. The button at the bottom left switches the mode.
AIP_NO_MODELS: No model found. Check the server in Settings -> AI assistant.
AIP_MODEL_TIP: Model of this chat (you can change it at any time)
AIP_DISABLED: The AI assistant is switched off. Turn it on in Settings -> AI assistant and choose a model.
AIP_DISABLED_REMOTE: (The settings can only be changed at the console.)
AIP_NO_MODEL: No model chosen yet. Pick one in the header or in Settings -> AI assistant.
SETTINGS_DMX_REINIT_DESC: Reconnects all DMX interfaces (Art-Net, sACN, USB) without restarting the application.
SETTINGS_RESET_TIP: Set everything in this category to its default values
SETTINGS_RESET_BODY: All settings of "{name}" go back to their default values. They only apply when you press Save; until then you can undo each change.
SETTINGS_RESET_DONE: "{name}" is set to the defaults - press Save to apply.
SETTINGS_RESET_ALL_BODY: All settings of all categories (including the language) go back to their default values. They only apply when you press Save; until then you can undo each change.
SETTINGS_RESET_ALL_DONE: All settings are set to the defaults - press Save to apply.
SETTINGS_DISCARD_ONE: You have 1 unsaved change - it will be lost when you close.
SETTINGS_DISCARD_N: You have {n} unsaved changes - they will be lost when you close.
RESET_CONFIRM_MESSAGE: Really reset all settings to their default values?
NEW_SHOW_CONFIRM: Create a new show? Unsaved changes will be lost.
UNSAVED_CHANGES_BODY: The current show has unsaved changes. Do you want to save before continuing?
FX_EMPTY: No fixtures patched yet — click 'Add Fixtures' to get started.
FXPROG_NO_DIMMER_HINT: The selected fixtures have no dimmer channel.
DMXI_NO_RANGES: The fixture file names no ranges for this channel.
FXED_IN_USE: This type is used by {n} fixtures in the show. Changes apply immediately – check the channel numbers afterwards.
FXED_E_ATTR: Channel {n}: the attribute is missing or not allowed (letters, digits, spaces, _ and -; it must start with a letter).
FXED_E_DUP: Channel {n}: the attribute “{a}” already exists in this mode (channel {m}).
FXED_E_DEFAULT: Channel {n}: the default value must be a whole number from 0 to 255.
FXED_E_RANGE: Channel {n}: every range needs its own start from 0 to 255, and the first must start at 0.
FXED_E_EXISTS: A type with this manufacturer and name already exists.
FXED_CANCEL_BODY: The fixture editor has changes that are not saved yet. They are lost if you cancel.
FXED_MODEL_HINT: Optional: a .glb, .3ds, .stl or .obj file (STL and OBJ are converted to GLB; 250,000 triangles at most). The size in metres sets how large it appears on the 3D stage.
FXED_S_model_too_detailed: The 3D model has too many triangles ({n}, at most {limit}). Please simplify it.
FXED_S_bad_model: The 3D model could not be read (allowed: .glb, .3ds, .stl, .obj; not too detailed).
FXED_DEL_MODE_BODY: Really delete the mode “{name}” with all its channels?
FXED_LOAD_FROM_HINT: Loads channels, functions and ranges as a copy to adjust (not wheels and geometry).
FXED_W_COUNT: Note: the mode “{name}” is used by {n} fixture(s) in the show. Its channel count changes from {a} to {b} – please check the DMX addresses afterwards.
FXED_W_GONE: Note: the mode “{name}” is used by {n} fixture(s) in the show but no longer exists after saving (deleted or renamed). Those fixtures fall back to the first mode.
FXLIB_PREVIEW_HINT: Preview – not installed yet. The file is only loaded temporarily.
FXLIB_CREDIT: Powered by GDTF – data from GDTF Share (gdtf-share.com)
ABOUT_GDTF: Powered by GDTF – fixture files and the online search come from GDTF Share (gdtf-share.com).
FXED_NOTE: The editor writes a real GDTF file into your library (the “fixtures” folder). You can copy it and import it on another computer. Own types count as unverified; wheels (gobos, colour wheels) are not available here.
FXED_TAGS_HINT: The library searches tags too (e.g. fog, outdoor, 12 V).
FXED_COPY_NOTE: Copy of an existing type. Not carried over:
FXED_MODE_ADD_TIP: Add a new mode as a copy of the selected one
FXED_CSV_EMPTY: No channels were found in the file. Expected: one line per channel with attribute; label; bit; default; ranges.
FXED_PICTURE_HINT: Shown in the library. The picture is written into the file as a PNG (512 pixels at most).
FXED_MODEL_MOVER: Moving heads (pan/tilt) get base, yoke and head as standard parts; an own 3D model is only available for fixed devices.
FXED_S_no_modes: At least one mode is required.
FXED_S_too_many: There are too many entries (at most {limit}).
FXED_S_bad_number: A number is invalid or out of range.
FXED_S_bad_file: The file is empty or damaged.
FXED_S_file_too_large: The file is too large (at most {mb} MB).
FXED_S_bad_image: The picture could not be read.
FXED_S_too_many_channels: A mode uses {n} DMX channels (at most {limit}).
FXLIB_COPY_EDIT_SUB: as the basis for an own type
FXLIB_REVEAL_FAIL: This only works on the computer running the program.
FX_OVERFLOW_WARN: Warning: end address {end} exceeds 512 in Universe {univ}. Reduce quantity or start address.
FXPROG_EMPTY: No fixtures patched — click 'Add' to get started.
FXPROG_DMX_EMPTY: Select a fixture to view its DMX channels
CMDLINE_PLACEHOLDER: Enter command... (e.g. Fixture 1 At 80 Zoom 50, Go; Tab = suggestions)
PRESET_EMPTY: No presets yet. Click '+ Preset' to add one.
CUE_CMD_PLACEHOLDER: Separate several commands with comma or semicolon: Fixture 1 At 100; Fixture 2 At 0
CUELIST_EMPTY: No cues yet. Program some values and click 'Save Cue'.
CUE_CTX_JUMP: Jump to This Cue / Fade Here
LAYOUT_DELETE_BODY: Really delete “{name}”? This cannot be undone.
UPDATE_MAIN_DEVICE_ONLY: Install it on the computer that runs OpenCue.
UPDATE_NONE: No release has been published yet.
UPDATE_OFFLINE: Could not check for updates. Is this computer online?
UPDATE_RATE_LIMIT: GitHub is limiting requests right now. Try again later.
UPDATE_ERR_CHECKSUM: The download is damaged (checksum does not match). Nothing was installed.
UPDATE_ERR_NETWORK: The download failed. Check the connection or use the release page.
SETTINGS_UPDATE_CHECK_HINT: At startup OpenCue asks GitHub whether a newer version exists. This needs internet; without a connection nothing happens and OpenCue keeps working offline.
HELP_VIEWER_FAILED: The guides could not be loaded.

ABOUT_THIRD_INTRO: OpenCue uses the following components. Tap one to read its license.
ABOUT_NO_TEXT: No license text is bundled for this component.
HOTKEYS_HINT: A key or combination (also with several keys, e.g. Ctrl+H+J) triggers a command when pressed. Set the key with the keyboard button of a row.
HOTKEYS_ON_TIP: Turn this key combination on or off
HOTKEYS_RUN_TIP: On: the command runs at once. Off: it is only written into the command line.
HOTKEYS_LOG_TIP: Show the command in the command line history
HOTKEYS_DUPLICATE: {keys} is already used in another row.
HOTKEYS_SCOPE_CLASH: {keys} is already used in another row. A key applies either to all keyboards or to specific ones - not both.
HOTKEYS_DEV_ONE_SUB_BROWSER: Only possible at the console on Windows
HOTKEYS_DEV_HINT: Now press the key or combination - for a macro pad, on the macro pad.
HOTKEYS_DEV_UNAVAILABLE: Keys of a specific keyboard are only possible at the console on Windows. {msg}
HOTKEYS_DEV_NOTE: Note: the key still reaches the active program as well. Best choose keys that otherwise do nothing (F13-F24, number pad).
SHORTCUTS_CMD_WINDOW: Command console as window: command line, keypad and command keys (open / close)
PANEL_DESC_TOGGLE: Toggle switch between on and off, each with its own command.
GUIDES_TIP: Alignment guides while moving and resizing panels (hold Alt to switch off briefly)
WIDGET_ACTION_WRITE: Write it into the command line
WIDGET_WRITE_APPEND: Append to the command line instead of replacing it
WIDGET_ACTION_HINT: Writing leaves the command in the command line; you confirm it yourself with Please or Enter. A fader writes its final value when released.
SIG_PANEL: Value of another panel (fader value, toggle 1/0, button pressed 1/0)
WRULE_COMMAND_LEAVE: Command once when it stops applying
WRULE_HINT: Checked from top to bottom: when the conditions apply, the colours and text of the rule are used (a later rule wins per property). Several conditions can be combined (all or at least one), each with any signal. In label texts {value} is this panel's value and {source} the followed state. Commands are sent once when the rule starts (or stops) to apply because of your own action (dragging, clicking, pressing), never because of changes from other devices; "Set the switch" applies on every device.
WRULE_COMMAND: Command once when it starts to apply
WSRC_HINT: The panel shows this state wherever it is changed (toolbar, command line, other panels, other devices). A toggle switches along with it (on = on or above 0); a button shows it through rules.
WSRC_HINT_FADER: The fader follows this value wherever it is changed (for example the brightness in the fixture control).
TOGGLE_LISTEN_ON: Also switch on when this command runs
TOGGLE_LISTEN_OFF: Also switch off when this command runs
TOGGLE_LISTEN_HINT: Listens to commands run anywhere that appear in the command history (command line, other buttons, other devices), also inside a chain. Example: Blackout On / Blackout Off.
STORAGE_CONFIRM_CHANGE_MSG: Change the data path to {path}? New showfiles, layouts and fixtures will be saved and loaded from there.
STORAGE_CONFIRM_RESET_MSG: Reset the storage path back to the default folder (%LOCALAPPDATA%\OpenCue)?
CLOSE_CONFIRM_BODY: Do you really want to quit the program?
FXE_EMPTY: No effects yet. Click '+ Effect' to create one.
FXS_NEW_HINT: New template loaded - not saved yet.
API_HINT: Other programs control OpenCue with tokens.
API_CORS: Allow web pages on other addresses
API_CORS_HINT: A web page opened from another address (your own dashboard, a web tool) may call the API from the browser. It still needs a token; without this switch the browser blocks such pages.
API_REMOTE_NOTE: From other devices use the address of this computer instead of 127.0.0.1 (see Remote). This needs 'Allow access from the network'.
API_NONE: No tokens yet. Create one to use the API.
API_CAP_READ_STATUS_DESC: State of the console: show name, blackout, grand master, timecode, selection.
API_CAP_READ_SHOW_DESC: Fixtures, groups, variables, effects, saved showfiles, cue lists and every cue with its timing and what it changes.
API_CAP_READ_DMX_DESC: The current DMX values of every universe and the live state (dimmer, colour, position) of each fixture.
API_CAP_WRITE_COMMAND_DESC: Run any command of the command line. Commands can also store, change and delete data of the show.
API_CAP_WRITE_CUE_DESC: Go, Back, jump to a cue, pause, resume, stop and the fader of a cue list.
API_CAP_WRITE_TIMECODE_DESC: Start, pause, stop, seek and change the speed of the global timecode.
API_CAP_WRITE_BLACKOUT_DESC: Switch the blackout and set the grand master.
API_CAP_WRITE_AUDIO_DESC: Open and close the audio source, change its settings (gain, sensitivity, tempo ...) and tap the tempo.
API_CAP_WRITE_DMX_DESC: Write single DMX channels or a single channel of a fixture. This overrides the running show, so it is off by default.
API_CAP_WRITE_PROGRAMMER_DESC: Select fixtures, set values (dimmer, color, position ...) and variables live, clear the programmer.
API_CAP_WRITE_SHOW_DESC: Create, change, copy, renumber and delete cue lists and cues (values, variables, effects, times, triggers).
API_CAP_WRITE_VARIABLES_DESC: Create, change and delete variables and variable groups. A changed variable changes every cue that uses it.
API_CAP_WRITE_EFFECTS_DESC: Create, change and delete effects and effect groups; start and stop effects on fixtures.
API_CAP_WRITE_SCRIPTS_DESC: Check, save and delete effect types (script files) in the user's effect folder.
API_CAP_WRITE_PATCH_DESC: Patch, change and delete fixtures (type, universe, address) and manage fixture groups. Deleting a fixture changes the cues that use it.
API_CAP_WRITE_SHOWFILE_DESC: New, load, save, rename, copy and delete showfiles. Loading or starting a new show replaces the running one.
API_CAP_WRITE_MEDIA_DESC: Upload video and audio files to the show, rename them and delete them.
API_CAP_WRITE_WIDGETS_DESC: Press, move and switch the console's own Button, Fader and Toggle panels (they run the commands set up in them).
API_CAP_WRITE_LAYOUT_DESC: Show a saved panel layout in the console window (unsaved layout changes there are lost).
API_CAP_READ_NOTES_DESC: List the chats and notes of the Chat & Notes panel, read their messages and text, and download them as Markdown.
API_CAP_WRITE_NOTES_DESC: Create, rename and delete chats and notes, send and delete messages, change or extend a note. The devices of the console see it at once.
API_CAP_WRITE_SETTINGS_DESC: Switch Art-Net, sACN and USB DMX, change their addresses, the default universe and the language. A wrong address can silence the lights.
API_CREATED_WARN: Copy the token now. For security it is shown only this once - afterwards only its first characters are visible.
SETTINGS_REMOTE_PASSWORD_SHORT: The password needs at least 4 characters.
SETTINGS_REMOTE_RESTART: A changed port takes effect after restarting OpenCue.
SETTINGS_REMOTE_STATUS_ON: Reachable on the network - open this address in the iPad's browser:
SETTINGS_REMOTE_STATUS_OFF: Local only ({url}) - nothing gets in from the network.
SETTINGS_REMOTE_STATUS_NONET: Enabled, but no network was found. Check the connection and click "Detect addresses again".
SETTINGS_REMOTE_PENDING: Click "Save" to apply the change right away (no restart needed).
SETTINGS_REMOTE_CANDIDATES: Once enabled, the console is reachable at these addresses:
SETTINGS_REMOTE_COPY_FAILED: Copying is not possible - select the address and copy it by hand.
SETTINGS_REMOTE_QR: Scan with the camera (iPad, phone). The password is asked when connecting.
SETTINGS_REMOTE_PORT_INVALID: The port must be between 1024 and 65535.
SETTINGS_REMOTE_HTTPS_HINT: A secure page (https) is needed for some browser features: keeping the iPad screen awake, the VR mode of the 3D simulation, microphone and camera in the browser - more will follow. OpenCue creates the certificate itself; the browser asks once to confirm it on the first visit. The https port takes effect at once.
SETTINGS_REMOTE_MDNS_HINT: OpenCue is also reachable as opencue.local - the same in any network. If the name is taken, opencue-2.local etc. is used.
SETTINGS_REMOTE_MDNS_ALIAS: opencue.local is already taken in the network - this console is reachable as {name}
SETTINGS_REMOTE_MDNS_WAIT: Looking for the name in the network and registering it ...
SETTINGS_REMOTE_MDNS_NEEDS_ACCESS: The name applies as soon as HTTP or HTTPS is allowed below.
SETTINGS_REMOTE_HTTPS_PORT_INVALID: The https port must be between 1024 and 65535 and differ from the HTTP port.
REMOTE_KICKED: You were disconnected by the host. Reload the page to sign in again.
WAKELOCK_UNSUPPORTED: Keeping the screen awake needs a secure page (HTTPS): open the https:// address (Settings → Remote access → Allow a secure page), or set the device's auto-lock to "Never".
wakeLock_unsupported: Keeping the screen awake needs a secure page (HTTPS): open the https:// address (Settings → Remote access → Allow a secure page), or set the device's auto-lock to "Never".
THEME_STATUS_HINT: Changing a status color away from green, yellow or red makes states harder to recognize.
THEME_TRANSFER_PLACEHOLDER: Theme as JSON – paste here to import
THEME_EXPORT_COPIED: Theme JSON copied to the clipboard.
THEME_IMPORT_INVALID: That is not a valid theme.
FXS_DELETE_FORBIDDEN: Only scripts in the user folder can be deleted.
LAYOUT_UPDATED_APPLIED: Layout “{name}” was updated by another device.
LAYOUT_UPDATED_PENDING: This layout was updated by another device
FULLSCREEN_UNSUPPORTED: This browser does not allow fullscreen. Tip: add the page to the home screen to run it as an app.
FXPROG_POS_FINE_NONE: The selected fixture has no fine channel for pan/tilt.
FXPROG_POS_FINE_SOME: {n} of {m} selected fixtures have a fine channel – only those use the fine values.
FXPROG_POS_SWIPE_HINT: Swipe up or down on the strip - the marks follow your finger.
SETTINGS_LAYOUT_SWIPE_HINT: Applies to this device only. A clear horizontal swipe outside lists, faders and input fields switches to the next/previous layout.
LAYOUT_NEW_DIRTY_WARNING: Unsaved changes to the current layout will be lost.
DISCARD_BODY: This window has input that has not been applied yet. It is lost if you close it.
SHOWFILE_DELETE_LOADED_NOTE: It is currently loaded: the show in memory is kept and counts as unsaved afterwards.
EXEC_LIST_AUTO: Active list (from the cue list panel)
EXEC_FADER_TIP: Mix: 100 % = full cue value, 0 % = manual value (not the overall brightness)
CUELIST_SAVE_CUE_TIP: Store the programmer state as a new cue or onto an existing number
CUELIST_UPDATE_TIP: Take the current values into the active cue
CUE_STORE_HINT_EXISTS: Cue {n} "{name}" already exists - when storing you choose Merge or Overwrite.
CUE_STORE_ERR_RANGE: The number must be between {lower} and {upper}.
CUE_STORE_ERR_RANGE_END: The number must be greater than {lower}.
CUE_CONFLICT_BODY: Cue {n} "{name}" already exists. How should it be stored?
CUE_CONFLICT_RENUMBER_BODY: Cue {n} "{name}" already exists. Merge takes the content of this cue into the existing one, Overwrite replaces the existing cue with this one.
CUE_CONFLICT_MERGE_HINT: Only the changed channels go into the cue, the rest stays as it was.
CUE_CONFLICT_OVERWRITE_HINT: The complete previous content is deleted and replaced by the current state.
CUE_UPDATE_BODY: Takes the current values into cue {n} "{name}".
CUE_UPDATE_NORMAL_HINT: Only this cue changes. Following cues that do not set these values themselves take them over when played (tracking).
CUE_UPDATE_ONLY_HINT: The change stays on this cue: the following cue keeps its previous look.
CUE_ERR_EMPTY: Nothing to store: nothing changed compared with the cue before (and no effect is running).
CUE_ERR_NO_ACTIVE: No active cue in this list - start a cue first.
CUE_ERR_RANGE: The number is outside the neighbouring cues.
CUE_DELAY_SWIPE_TIP: Delay: swipe up/down to change the value (all selected cues together), tap to type
EXEC_PROP_SMART: Smart layout (large Go, the other buttons below)
EXEC_PROP_SHOW_TITLE: Show title (cue list and current position)
CUELIST_DELETE_LIST_BODY: Permanently delete cue list “{name}” with {n} cue(s)? Executors using this list switch to the active list.
CUE_ERR_TRIGGER: Invalid trigger - allowed: Go, Follow, Timecode (e.g. "tc 4.3"), Audio (e.g. "audio kick", "audio beat 4", "audio bass 70"), MIDI (e.g. "midi note c4", "midi cc 20 64", "midi pc 5") or Clock (e.g. "clock 19:30", "clock 20:00 sat,sun").
CUE_ERR_MIB: Invalid MIB value - allowed: On/Off, 1/0, True/False or Auto.
SHORTCUTS_UNDO: Undo (panel layout in edit mode, otherwise cues, variables, groups, selection)
SHORTCUTS_REDO: Redo (panel layout in edit mode, otherwise cues, variables, groups, selection)
SHORTCUTS_SIM3D_DUPLICATE: Duplicate Object (press again to repeat the offset)
SIM3D_POSE_COPY_TIP: Remember position and rotation of the selected part (Ctrl+C for fixtures)
SIM3D_POSE_PASTE_TIP: Apply the remembered position and rotation (with several selected only the rotation; Ctrl+V for fixtures)
SIM3D_POSE_PASTE_ROT_TIP: Apply only the remembered rotation (also with several selected)
SIM3D_ALIGN_TIP: Set all selected parts to the same coordinate as the part selected last
SIM3D_DISTRIBUTE_TIP: Spread evenly between the first and the last part (from three parts)
SHORTCUTS_SIM3D_GROUP: Several selected: handles and arrows act on all (fixtures turn in place, Alt = rigid around the centre; the other way round for bodies)
SIM3D_FIXTURES_MULTI_TIP: Multi-select: every tap in the list adds or removes
SIM3D_FRAME_TIP: Bring selection into view (F, double-click in the list)
SHORTCUTS_SIM3D_LIST: In the list: Shift = range, Ctrl = add, double-click = bring into view
SHORTCUTS_SIM3D_MOUSE: Left: select / move / drag a frame · Right: rotate view · Middle: pan · Wheel: zoom
SHORTCUTS_SIM3D_RESIZE: While resizing: Shift = proportional, Alt = from the centre
SHORTCUTS_SIM3D_NUDGE: Move Selection (Shift = 5x); no layout switch while selected
SIMSTAGE_SAVE_TIP: Writes the active stage to its file (a new stage asks for a name).
SIMSTAGE_REPLACE_BODY: "{name}" has unsaved changes that are lost when replaced. Replace?
CUELIST_PROP_LIST_HINT: Only used when the list selector is hidden: the panel then always shows this list.
FXLV_BANNER: Build mode: drag fixtures, empty area = select
FXLV_ZOOM_HINT: Ctrl + mouse wheel = zoom · drag middle button = pan
FXLV_RESET_BODY: All fixtures are placed in order again (10 per row). Your own positions are lost.
FXLV_VIEW_NAME: Name of the view (for example Stage left)
FXLV_VIEW_TIP: Jumps to this view (right-click: overwrite, rename, delete)
FXGRP_DELETE_BODY: Really delete group “{name}”? The fixtures are kept, they just no longer belong to a group.
FXGRP_HEADER_TIP: Click: select / deselect all fixtures of this group
FXGRP_EMPTY: Empty – assign fixtures via right-click → “Edit fixture…”

FXV_HIGH_H: The highest value the effect uses.

FXV_GOBO_HIGH_H: Where the range on the gobo wheel / rotation ends (%).
FXV_WIDTH_H: Width of the moving spot, in fixtures.
FXV_WAVES_H: How many wavelengths fit across the selection.
FXV_STROBE_H: Flashes per second inside the lit phase (0 = off).
FXV_GAIN_H: How strongly the effect reacts to the music.
FXV_MODE_H: Variant of the effect (see the description).
FXV_EVERY_H: Change only on every n-th beat (1 = every beat).
FXV_TRAIL_H: Length of the fading tail, in fixtures.
FXV_BASE_H: The level (or colour) between the hits.
FXV_PEAK_H: The value at the moment of a hit.
FXV_DENSITY_H: Share of the fixtures that take part each time (%).
FXV_DUTY_H: Length of one flash as a share of the period (%).
FXV_STEPS_H: Number of fixed values the effect steps through.
FXV_BOUNCE_H: 1 = run back and forth instead of around.
FXV_FIRST_H: Number of the first gobo used (0 = the first one).
FXV_WARM_H: The warm end of the fade.
FXV_COOL_H: The cool end of the fade.
FXV_CENTER_H: The value the movement is centred on (%).
FXV_AMOUNT_H: How far the value swings around the centre (%).
FXV_FADE_H: How long a flash takes to fade out (seconds).
FXV_LENGTH_H: Length of the whole sequence in seconds.
FXV_FLIP_H: 1 reverses the order of the fixtures.
FXV_PAUSE_H: Pause between two bursts in seconds.
FXV_MULT_H: How many flashes fit into one beat.
FXV_FLASHES_H: Number of flashes in one burst.
FXV_DROP_H: Above this level (%) the lights strobe (100 = never).
FXV_SOFTNESS_H: How long the light lingers after a beat (smaller = longer).
FXV_BEATS_H: How many beats one full swing takes.
FXV_CENTER_PAN_H: The pan position the movement is centred on (50 = middle).
FXV_CENTER_TILT_H: The tilt position the movement is centred on (50 = middle).
FXV_HUE_FROM_H: Where the range of colours starts, in degrees of the colour wheel (0 = red, 120 = green, 240 = blue).

FXV_SATURATION_H: How vivid the colours are (100 = vivid, low = pastel).
FXV_GLIDE_H: How smoothly the heads glide to the new position (0 = jump, 1 = very slow).
FXV_SOURCE_H: Which part of the music drives the effect (see the description).

CUELIST_DUPE_NAME: A cue list named '{name}' already exists.
API_DELETE_BODY: The token "{name}" is deleted. Programs that use it lose access immediately.
API_REGENERATE_BODY: The old token of "{name}" stops working immediately.
THEME_PROFILE_DELETE_BODY: The colour profile "{name}" will be deleted.
FXLIB_UNINSTALL_BODY: "{name}" is removed from your fixture library.
AIP_DELETE_CHAT_BODY: The chat "{name}" and all its messages will be deleted. This cannot be undone.

PRESET_MIXED_TIP: The selected fixtures have different sources here (effect, variable or manual). Moving a fader sets all of them to manual.
SETTINGS_INTRO_DEFAULTS: Starting values that apply to the whole program, for every show.
DEFAULTS_SECTION_CUES_HINT: Used when a new cue is stored and nothing else is chosen there (store dialog, command, REST API). Existing cues do not change.
DEFAULTS_CUE_PLAY_HINT: Relative plays only your changes, absolute sets every fixture exactly as it was when stored. The full state is always stored.
DEFAULTS_SECTION_CLEAR_HINT: How the fixtures stand after "Clear Clear" and at program start. All other channels (gobo, prism, zoom, focus ...) are at 0.
DEFAULTS_CLEAR_DIMMER_HINT: 0 % = dark. Fixtures without a dimmer channel stay dark.
DEFAULTS_CLEAR_COLOR_HINT: White is handy: raise the brightness afterwards and you see light at once. Pure RGB fixtures without a dimmer channel stay black, their colour is their brightness.
DEFAULTS_SAVE_FAILED: The defaults could not be saved.
DEFAULTS_CUE_TRIGGER_HINT: Go = you start the cue yourself. Follow = it starts by itself as soon as the previous one is done (after the delay).
DEFAULTS_UPDATE_HINT: Applies to the Update button and the plain Update command. The other way stays available by command: Update Tracking / Update CueOnly.
DEFAULTS_SECTION_START_HINT: Only applies when OpenCue starts. A show loaded later brings its own state.
DEFAULTS_START_BLACKOUT_HINT: OpenCue starts dark; "Blackout Off" or the button brings the light back.
DEFAULTS_EXECUTOR_START_HINT: Level for cue lists the show has not stored a fader level for yet (new lists). Usual: 100 %.
DICT_SECTION_HINT: The microphone button in the AI chat writes what you say into the input field. The language is that of the interface (German or English).
DICT_DEVICE_HINT: Independent of the microphone for the wake word and of the audio analysis.
DICT_MODEL_HINT: Loaded once at the first dictation (internet needed), then everything runs offline. "Accurate" recognises German in particular better, but takes longer.
DICT_MODEL_FAILED: The speech model could not be loaded (internet?).
DICT_DOWNLOADING: Loading the speech model ({p} %) - only the first time ...
DICT_ERR_OPEN: The microphone could not be opened (in use or blocked?).
DICT_ERR_LOCAL: Dictation only works at the console.
DICT_ERR_DOWNLOAD: The speech model could not be loaded (internet?).
DICT_ERR_TRANSCRIBE: Writing it down failed (see the log).
IO_SECTION: All audio devices of this computer
IO_SECTION_HINT: Everything Windows knows as audio inputs and outputs - whether or not OpenCue uses it.
SETTINGS_INTRO_DICT: Speech to text in the AI chat - the speech model runs on this computer.
SETTINGS_INTRO_IO: Which output or input is used for what - overview only, each one is set at its own place.
IOV_USED_HINT: Dot green = active, empty = off, yellow = error. Right: how far the connection reaches.

IOV_ROLE_HTTPS: Remote access via https (secure page: iPad stays awake, VR)
IOV_ROLE_CLIENTS: Windows and devices connected to the program
IOV_ROLE_ANALYSIS: Source of the audio analysis (audio panel)
IOV_ROLE_KB_ALL: Shortcuts that any keyboard can trigger
IOV_ROLE_KB_DEVICE: Shortcuts that only this keyboard triggers
IOV_ROLE_KB_IDLE: Detected keyboard (no shortcuts of its own)
SETTINGS_REMOTE_MASTER_HINT: Off: nothing leaves this computer. When you switch it on, Windows asks once - allow "Private networks".
REMOTE_PW_BODY: Remote access and lock mode need a password of your own - there is no default password. You can change it at any time under Settings → Security.
API_REACH_NEEDS_REMOTE: Other devices only get through when remote access is on.
IOV_D_NEEDS_REMOTE: meant for the network, but remote access is off
SETTINGS_ARTNET_HINT: Sends DMX into the network. Nothing leaves this computer until you switch it on.
SETTINGS_SACN_HINT: Sends DMX as multicast into the network. Windows may ask about the firewall the first time.
NET_HINT: OpenCue only needs the internet for updates and GDTF Share. The test shows whether it works - and what is in the way if not.
NET_ERR_BLOCKED: Access blocked - a firewall or security software does not let OpenCue onto the network
NET_ERR_TLS_CERT: The certificate is not trusted - an antivirus or the company network inspects encrypted connections
NET_ERR_PROXY: Direct works, but not through the Windows proxy
FXPROG_POS_JOY_HINT: Drag the knob: the further out, the faster. In the inner circle it is precise - let go and the fixture stops.
API_VIEWS_HINT: Plain read-only displays, e.g. for an ESP32 display or a wall tablet: /api/v1/views/status.png, dmx, timecode ...
API_CONNS_NONE: No device is connected through the WebSocket right now.
API_EDIT_NOTE: Changes apply when you press Save in the settings.
API_CREATE_NOTE: The token is created at once and shown right after - copy it then.
DEFAULTS_SECTION_DELETE_HINT: Ask before deleting? Off = delete at once, without asking. Default: ask.
DEFAULTS_DEL_FILES: Files (shows, layouts, stages, models, media, colour profiles): confirmation
DEFAULTS_DEL_OTHER: Other (AI chats, API tokens, 3D objects): confirmation
VOICE_CMD_MODEL: Speech model missing - load it under Settings -> Dictation

MIDI_ENABLED_TIP: Off: OpenCue listens to no MIDI device - other programs can use it then.
MIDI_OUTPUT_TIP: This is where the command "Midi ..." (e.g. Midi Note 60) sends to.
MIDI_EMPTY: No MIDI mapping yet. Start with "New MIDI mapping".
MIDI_M_TRIGGER_TIP: The command runs when the key is pressed.
MIDI_M_TOGGLE_TIP: Every press switches between the command and the off command.
MIDI_M_HOLD_TIP: The command runs on press, the release command on release.
MIDI_M_FADER_TIP: A fader: the command gets the value as {value}.
MIDI_M_RELATIVE_TIP: An endless encoder: the command gets the steps as {delta} (with a sign).
MIDI_RUN_TIP: Off: the command is only written into the command line.
MIDI_LOG_TIP: The command appears in the command line history.
MIDI_ON_TIP: Switch this mapping on or off
MIDI_LEARN_WAIT: Press a key or move a fader on the MIDI device ... ({n} s)
MIDI_LEARN_HINT: The first signal that arrives is taken. You can also enter it by hand below.
MIDI_LEARN_LOCAL_ONLY: Learning only works at the console computer. Here you can enter the signal by hand.
MIDI_DUP: This signal is already used in another row - both rows will trigger.
MIDI_MONITOR_HINT: Shows what your device sends - that is how you find note and controller numbers.
MIDI_MONITOR_EMPTY: Nothing received yet. Press a key or move a fader.
IOV_ROLE_MIDI_MAP: Keys, faders and program changes trigger commands
IOV_D_MIDI_BUSY: cannot be opened - maybe another program uses the device
IOV_ROLE_MIDI_NONE: Plug in a USB device - it is recognised automatically
IOV_ROLE_MIDI_OUT: MIDI output: the command "Midi ..." sends here
SETTINGS_INTRO_KB: Keyboard shortcuts and your own key mapping.
KB_SECTION_HINT: Look at the shortcuts and define your own.
MIDI_SET_ENABLE_HINT: Off: no device is read - other programs can use it.
MIDI_SET_STATE_BUSY: in use - does another program use the device?
MIDI_SET_OUT_HINT: This is where the command "Midi ..." sends to.
MIDI_IMPORT_FAILED: The file contains no MIDI mapping
MIDI_ASSIGN_HINT: Creates a MIDI mapping with this command and learns the signal right away. The mapping stays even without this panel.
MIDI_SET_CLOCK_HINT: A steady MIDI clock (30-300 BPM) sets the tempo.
MIDI_PICKUP_TIP: The fader only takes over once it has reached the current value - no jump when you first touch it. Works for master and fader (commands "Master {value}", "Fader {value}", "Cuelist <name> Fader {value}"); other commands take over at once.
MIDI_SET_MTC_HINT: The global timecode runs in step with MIDI Timecode.
HOTKEYS_IMPORTED_SKIPPED: {n} imported, {skipped} skipped (key already used or taken by the program)
HOTKEYS_IMPORT_FAILED: The file contains no keyboard mapping
TRANSFER_STARTED: The download starts in the browser
TRANSFER_FAILED: The file could not be offered
TRANSFER_BAD_FILE: The file is not a valid JSON file
SETTINGS_IO_HINT: Save all settings as a file or take them over from a file. Imported values show up as changes - Save applies them.
SETTINGS_IMPORT_DONE: Settings loaded: {n} changes - apply them with Save
SETTINGS_IMPORT_SAME: The file contains nothing that differs from the current settings
SETTINGS_IMPORT_INVALID: The file is not an OpenCue settings file
MIDI_M_DOUBLE_TIP: The command runs on the second press within 0.4 seconds.
MIDI_M_LONG_TIP: The command runs when the key is held long enough.
MIDI_TPL_FADERS_SUB: Each fader sets the brightness of one fixture
MIDI_TPL_MASTER_SUB: One fader and one key with feedback
MIDI_TPL_HINT: The rows are created, then you press or move one control after the other.
CUE_MIDI_TRIGGER: Jump to this cue with a MIDI key ...
MIDI_SET_MTC_OUT_HINT: The global timecode goes to the output as MIDI Timecode.
MIDI_SET_CLOCK_OUT_HINT: Start, stop and clock at the tempo of the Audio panel while the timecode runs.
MIDI_SET_MSC_HINT: GO, STOP, RESUME, ALL_OFF and RESTORE control the cue lists.
FM_LOCK: Lock this show (no more saving, renaming or deleting)
FM_ERR_LOCKED: This show is locked. Unlock it first (lock symbol).
CLOSE_WARN_locked: It is locked (file manager, lock symbol).
CLOSE_WARN_folder_unwritable: The folder cannot be written to.
CLOSE_WARN_save_failed: The last attempt to save failed: {error}
CLOSE_WARN_BACKUP: A backup copy of your changes is kept (File → Restore backup).
CLOSE_WARN_NO_BACKUP: Backups are switched off: your changes will be lost.
CLOSE_SAVE_COPY_AND_QUIT: Save as a copy and quit...
CLOSE_DISCARD_ARMED: Click again: quit and lose the changes
SHOW_SAVE_LOCKED: Not saved: "{name}" is locked. Use Save as... for a copy or unlock it in the file manager.
BACKUP_INTRO: OpenCue saves the current state of your show in the background - also changes you did not save. Pick a backup to load it as an unsaved show; the show file itself is not changed.
BACKUP_RESTORED: Restored "{name}" from {time}. It is not saved yet - use Save or Save as.
BACKUP_RESTORE_FAILED: The backup could not be restored: {error}
BACKUP_NOW_NOTHING: Nothing to back up: no unsaved changes.
BACKUP_RECOVERY_BODY: Last time OpenCue ended unexpectedly. A backup of "{name}" from {time} is available. Restore it?
SETTINGS_BACKUP_ENABLED: Back up the show in the background
SETTINGS_BACKUP_HINT: Saves the current state - also unsaved changes - to the backups folder, only when something changed. Handy when you program before an event and deliberately do not save during it. A backup never replaces the show file; restore it with File → Restore backup.
HELP_REPORT_COPIED: The diagnostics are in the clipboard - paste them into the report.
HELP_REPORT_MANUAL: The report page is open. Copy the diagnostics from the log folder (opencue.log).
SYS_FIREWALL_HINT: Without a rule Windows asks once whether OpenCue may use the network; a refused or unanswered question blocks tablets, sACN and the network name. The rule allows only this program, only in private and domain networks - never in public ones.
SYS_FIREWALL_OK: A firewall rule for OpenCue exists.
SYS_FIREWALL_NONE: No firewall rule for OpenCue yet.
SYS_FIREWALL_WAIT: Waiting for Windows - please confirm the question...
SYS_FIREWALL_CANCELLED: Cancelled: Windows asked for administrator rights and the question was not confirmed.
SYS_FIREWALL_FAILED: The firewall rule could not be changed.
SYS_ADMIN_YES: OpenCue runs as administrator. That is not needed and not recommended: Windows then blocks dragging files from Explorer into the window.
SYS_ADMIN_NO: OpenCue runs without administrator rights (recommended). Creating the rule asks Windows for permission once - OpenCue itself is not restarted as administrator.
SYS_AUTOSTART_ENABLED: Start OpenCue when I sign in to Windows
SYS_AUTOSTART_HINT: Only for this Windows user. Without a window OpenCue runs in the background (icon in the notification area) and is used from a browser or a remote device.
SYS_AUTOSTART_UNAVAILABLE: Only available in the installed program.
SYS_AUTOSTART_FAILED: Start with Windows could not be changed.
SC_EDIT_HINT: Click a key, then press the new combination and release it – it is set at once. Esc cancels. The cross turns a shortcut off, the arrow restores the standard key.
SC_ERR_ROW: {keys} is already used by a custom key command (Controls → Custom keyboard shortcuts).
SC_ERR_ONEKEY: A program shortcut has one main key plus Ctrl, Alt or Shift.
SC_ERR_BARE: A single letter or number key would block typing - add Ctrl or Alt (function keys work alone).
CUE_EDIT_CLOCK_HINT: The cue waits as the next cue of a running list until the clock reaches this time (Controls → Schedule runs commands at a time).
CUE_ERR_CLOCK_TIME: Enter a time of day such as 19:30 or 19:30:15.
SCH_INTRO: Commands that run at a time of day - on certain weekdays or once on a date. The schedule belongs to the show and is saved with it. A cue can also wait for a time: trigger "Time of day" in the cue dialog.
SCH_DATE_HINT: Optional: run once on this date (then the weekdays are ignored)
SCH_RUN_HINT: Run the command now to try it
DMXIN_INTRO: OpenCue receives DMX over the network – from a lighting desk, a program or a device. The values can be mixed into the output or passed on, and single channels can trigger commands (jump to a cue, Go, blackout, master …).
DMXIN_WARNING: DMX has no password: anyone in the network can send. That is why the input is off by default; “Allowed senders” restricts it.
DMXIN_ALLOW_PH: empty = anyone, otherwise IP addresses or prefixes, e.g. 192.168.1.
DMXIN_BIND_PH: empty = all (otherwise the adapter's IP address)
DMXIN_TIMEOUT_HINT: If no packet arrives for this long, OpenCue releases the source's values (with sACN immediately when the source reports “stream terminated”).
DMXIN_NO_MERGE: (The output is running inside the main program right now: triggers and display work, mixing into the output does not.)
DMXIN_SOURCES_HINT: Everything currently sent on the network. “View” shows the 512 channels, “Forward” creates a mapping right away.
DMXIN_ENABLE_FIRST: Switch on “Receive DMX” to see sources.
DMXIN_FORWARD_TIP: Creates a mapping: this universe is mixed into the output (highest wins).
DMXIN_MERGE_HINT: An input universe is mixed into an OpenCue output universe. “Highest wins”: per channel the larger value counts. “Replace”: the input counts while the source is there. An output universe without fixtures is still output (pure forwarding, e.g. Art-Net → sACN).
DMXIN_TRIGGERS_HINT: A channel runs console commands. “Button”: when the value rises above the threshold the first command runs; when it falls below again, the second (optional). “Fader”: every new value runs as a command, {value} stands for the value (scaled to the range). “Learn”: then move the channel at the desk.
DMXIN_LEARN_HINT: Then move a channel at the desk: protocol, universe and channel are taken over.
OSC_INTRO: Control OpenCue from other programs and devices over the network (TouchOSC, QLab, Ableton ...) and send OSC messages yourself. Incoming messages run commands: the built-in addresses below work at once, and you can map your own addresses to commands.
OSC_WARNING: OSC has no password: anyone in the network can send. Switch it on only in a network you trust, and name the allowed senders below if you can.
OSC_READONLY: OSC can only be changed at the console computer itself.
OSC_STATUS_OFF: OSC is off - nothing is received.
OSC_STATUS_ERROR: The port could not be opened: {error}
OSC_RAW_HINT: /opencue/cmd "<command>" runs ANY console command - also Delete. Only switch it on if you need it and trust all senders.
OSC_SEND_FAILED: The message could not be sent.
OSC_SEND_HINT: The console command  Osc /address 0.5  sends a message to this target.
OSC_EMPTY: No mappings yet. "Learn" takes the address of the next message that arrives.
OSC_LEARN_HINT: Send the message now from your app: its address is taken over
OSC_COMMAND_PH: Command, e.g. Cuelist Main Go or Master {value}
OSC_SCALE_HINT: Convert the value 0..1 to this range (off: use the value as sent)
OSC_LOG_HINT: Show the command in the command history (a fader stream would flood it)
SETTINGS_ARTNET_AUTO_HINT: OpenCue looks for Art-Net devices in the network and sends to each of them directly - plug in a node and it just works. Switch it off to use a fixed Target IP.
ARTNET_NODES_AUTO: {n} device(s) found - OpenCue sends to each of them:
ARTNET_NODE_USE_HINT: Use this device as a fixed target (takes effect with Save)
ARTNET_NONE_FOUND: No Art-Net device answered. Check the cable, the power and that the device is in the same network; the Windows firewall may need an OpenCue rule (Settings → Remote access).
ARTNET_SCAN_LOCAL_ONLY: The search can only be started at the console computer.
OSC_BUILTIN_PREFIX_HINT: All built-in addresses start with this, e.g. /opencue/go. Change it if another program already uses /opencue.
SETTINGS_INTRO_OSC: Control OpenCue from tablets and other programs over the network (TouchOSC, QLab ...).
OSC_SET_ENABLE_HINT: Off by default. Switching it on opens a UDP port in the network - Windows may ask once whether OpenCue may use the network.
REPORT_INTRO: Documentation of this show for technicians - as a PDF to save or print. Choose what it should contain.
REPORT_PATCH_HINT: every fixture with number, type, universe and DMX address
REPORT_UNIVERSES_HINT: which fixture occupies which channels of each universe; overlaps in red
REPORT_GROUPS_HINT: which fixture belongs to which group
REPORT_PLAN_HINT: where the fixtures are - from the 3D stage, otherwise from the fixture layout view
REPORT_CUES_HINT: cue number, name, trigger and times
REPORT_OPENED: The PDF opens in your viewer - print it there (Ctrl+P).
FXI_INTRO: Add many fixtures at once from a table (.csv or Excel .xlsx). The first row holds the column titles: name, type, mode, universe, address, number, count - only the type is needed.
FXI_TEMPLATE: Download the current patch as CSV (template)
FXI_READ_FAILED: The file could not be read.
FXI_DEFAULT_TYPE: Type when the cell is empty
SIMJSON_BTN_TIP: Advanced: edit the stage (room, objects, fixture positions) as text
SIMJSON_INTRO: The working copy of the stage as text: room settings, objects and fixture positions (metres, degrees, Z up). Fixtures are listed by their number. Check shows what would be taken over; Apply works like a change in the 3D panel (then save the stage as usual).
SIMJSON_TOO_BIG: The text is too large (at most 2 MB).

WELCOME_REMOTE_HINT: Other devices in your network open OpenCue in a browser and sign in with a password.
WELCOME_PASSWORD: Choose a password for other devices
WELCOME_PASSWORD_HINT: At least 4 characters, and not the built-in default password.
WELCOME_OSC_HINT: OSC has no password: only switch it on in a network you trust.
WELCOME_SUM_NONE: Nothing - OpenCue stays on this computer only.
WELCOME_LATER: Everything is in Settings. The guides (Help → Guides, F1) explain the rest; Help → What's new lists the latest changes.

SETTINGS_INTRO_SECURITY: One password protects remote access and the lock screen.
SEC_PASSWORD_HINT: There is no default password: you choose it yourself (at least 4 characters). It is used for remote access and for the lock screen.
SEC_LOCK_HINT: Lock the console with the lock button in the top bar, Ctrl+L or Controls → Lock. A locked console shows only a password window; the show keeps running.
SEC_AUTO_HINT: Without any input at the console. Remote devices log out after the same time.

RELOAD_LAYOUT_KEPT: Panels rebuilt - your unsaved changes were kept.
SC_OPEN_HINT: Press ? anywhere to show or hide this overview.

SP_NO_FIXTURES: No fixtures in this show yet.

SETTINGS_INTRO_ADVANCED: Quick switches, keeping the screen awake, what the toolbar shows at the top right, and the test of the internet connection.
SYS_FIREWALL_AT_CONSOLE: Windows asks for permission on the main computer - confirm it there.
SETTINGS_INTRO_TIMECODE: Let OpenCue follow an external clock: LTC, timecode as an audio signal. (MIDI timecode is under MIDI.)
LTC_SECTION_HINT: A player, a DJ or show program or a console puts the time on an audio track. OpenCue reads it from an audio input and then runs exactly in time with it: cues with the trigger "Timecode" fire to the music.
LTC_ENABLE_HINT: While a valid signal arrives, the global timecode runs with it. If it stops, the timecode stops too.
LTC_DEVICE_DEMO: Test signal (25 fps, no device needed)
LTC_CHANNEL_HINT: The timecode usually sits on one channel (often the left); the music on the other.
LTC_ERR_OPEN: The input cannot be opened (used by another program?).
LTC_FOLLOW_HINT: Pause or stop of the source stops the timecode here as well. To play along yourself, switch LTC off.
PANEL_DESC_TIMELINE: Graphical timeline: cues and commands as markers on the time axis, with the waveforms of the songs from the media players underneath. Drag markers, play and set cues along with the music.
TL_SET_HERE_TIP: The selected cue gets the current time (Enter); then the next cue is selected
TL_AUDIO_ON: Play the audio with the timecode
TL_NO_LISTS: No cue list yet - you can already use command tracks (+).
TL_TRAY_TITLE: Cues without a time in “{name}” - drag one onto its track, or select it and use “Set cue here”
TL_TRAY_EMPTY: All cues of this list have a time.
TL_TRAY_NO_CUES: This list has no cues yet.
TL_CHIP_TIP: Select, or drag onto the timeline
TL_NOTHING_TO_SET: No cue to set - select a cue list and a cue first.
TL_WAVE_NONE: Choose audio above to see its waveform.
TL_WAVE_FFMPEG: No waveform: ffmpeg was not found.
TL_AUDIO_CLEAR: Remove the audio from the timeline
LTC_SRC_HINT: There is one global clock (the timecode). It is started here (Timecode panel), or it follows an outside source: MIDI timecode (Settings → MIDI) or LTC (below). Whoever is there first leads.
LTC_SRC_NOW: The clock is currently led by:
LTC_OUT_HINT: OpenCue becomes the clock for other devices: while the timecode runs forward (for example after Play in the Timecode panel), LTC comes out of an audio output. A player, console or recorder can run along.
LTC_OUT_ENABLE_HINT: Only while the clock runs forward - when it stops or runs backwards the output is silent.
LTC_OUT_CHANNEL_HINT: Use one channel if the other one carries music.
LTC_OUT_LEVEL_HINT: Strong but not clipping; many devices want line level.
LTC_OUT_ST_IDLE: Ready - sends as soon as the timecode runs
IOV_ROLE_LTC_IN: Reads LTC: timecode as an audio signal
IOV_ROLE_LTC_OUT: Sends LTC while the clock runs
IOV_ROLE_MTC_OUT: MIDI timecode out (sent from the clock)
TL_ADD_CMD_TIP: Adds a command at the current time on the selected command track (C)
TL_TRACK_DELETE_BODY: Really delete the track “{name}” with all its commands?
TL_CMD_HINT: Any command of the command line. It runs when the timecode runs forward through this time - like a cue.
TL_AUDIO_ADD_TIP: Adds an audio of its own to this timeline (the audio of media players appears by itself)
TL_AUDIO_AUTO_HINT: Audio of media players (mode Timecode) appears here by itself.
TL_AUDIO_NONE_LANE: No audio yet - choose an audio in a media player (mode Timecode, start time) or add one here.
TL_AUDIO_START_EDIT: Drag to change when the audio starts (double-click = type the time)
TL_AUDIO_START_LOCKED: The start time is set in the media player of the other device / the 3D screen.
KA_ENABLE: Keep computer and screen awake while OpenCue runs
KA_HINT: During a show the computer must not go to sleep or lock. Tablets (iPad) keep their screen on by themselves - that needs a secure page (HTTPS).
KA_ST_NOT_WINDOWS: This computer: only available on Windows.
KA_ST_OFF: Off - the computer / device may go to sleep and lock the screen.
KA_ST_WINDOWS_ON: This computer: Windows is kept awake - no sleep, no lock by inactivity.
KA_ST_PENDING: Switched on - takes effect after Save.
KA_ST_DEVICE_OK: This device: the screen stays on (screen wake lock active).
KA_ST_NEEDS_HTTPS: This device: not possible on this page - the browser only allows it on a secure page (HTTPS). Open the https:// address, or set the device's auto-lock to "Never".
KA_ST_DEVICE_NA: This device: the browser does not support it. Set the device's auto-lock to "Never".
CUE_COPY_HINT: The other copies keep the spacing of the originals. Numbers that already exist are not overwritten.
CUE_COPY_BODY: Copy {n} cues (with all values, effects and times).
CUE_COPY_BODY_ONE: Copy this cue (with all values, effects and times).
CUE_ERR_COPY_CONFLICT: Not copied: the numbers {n} already exist. Choose another start number.
CUE_TRIG_HINT_follow: Starts by itself after the previous cue (plus the delay).
CUE_TRIG_HINT_timecode: Starts when the timecode reaches the given time.
CUE_TRIG_HINT_audio: Starts on a beat or level of the audio analysis.
CUE_TRIG_HINT_midi: Starts on a MIDI note, controller or program change.
CUE_TRIG_HINT_clock: Starts at a time of day (and on chosen weekdays).
UNDOGO_TIP: Undo also covers Go / Back: off
UNDOGO_ON: Undo also covers Go / Back: on
QS_HINT: These switches act immediately - also when their button is hidden in the toolbar.
OFFLINE_NOT_FOUND: No OpenCue answers there. Check address, port and HTTPS.
OFFLINE_HINT: Tip: the name opencue.local finds the computer even when its IP address changes.
OFFLINE_BAD_ADDRESS: Please enter an address or IP (for example opencue.local or 192.168.1.20).
CERT_HINT: Install the certificate once on each device and trust it: then the secure page (HTTPS) works without a warning, the home-screen app opens and the offline page works. The guide page explains every step.
CERT_QR: Scan with the iPad camera (opens the guide page)
CERT_NEEDS_HTTP: Note: switch on access over HTTP for a moment - without trust the profile can only be loaded without a warning over http://.
CP_LEAD: One-time setup per device. Afterwards OpenCue opens over https without a warning, the home-screen app works and the offline page can load - even when the computer gets a new IP address.
CP_S1_B: In Safari, tap the button. When iOS asks "This website is trying to download a configuration profile. Do you want to allow this?", tap Allow, then Close. Nothing is installed yet.
CP_S2_B: Open the Settings app. At the top you see "Profile Downloaded" (or: Settings > General > VPN & Device Management > Downloaded Profile). Tap it, tap Install at the top right, enter the device passcode and confirm Install twice.
CP_S3_B: In the Settings app: General > About > Certificate Trust Settings. Under "Enable full trust for root certificates" switch on "OpenCue Local CA" and confirm. Without this step the profile alone does nothing.
CP_S4_B: Open the secure address in Safari - no warning should appear. For the home-screen app: Share button > Add to Home Screen. Delete an old OpenCue icon first.
CP_NO_CERT: There is no certificate yet. On the computer: Settings > Remote access > "Allow a secure page (HTTPS)".
CP_HTTPS_OFF: The secure page is switched off. On the computer: Settings > Remote access > "Allow a secure page (HTTPS)".
CP_CHECK_B: The SHA-256 fingerprint of the certificate (compare it on the computer under Settings > Remote access):{fp}
CP_WHY_B: Without trust iOS only allows "visit this website anyway" inside a Safari tab. A home-screen app then shows a warning every time or stays blank, and the offline page (service worker) is not allowed. With the certificate installed, https is valid on every address of the computer.
CP_SAFE_B: The certificate may only vouch for local names (.local, localhost) and private network addresses - not for internet sites. You can remove it any time: Settings > General > VPN & Device Management.
CERT_PAGE: Guide page (open it on the iPad)
CP_SAFARI_B: The profile can only be installed from Safari. It does not work from the home-screen app, from Chrome or from the browser inside another app. Not in Safari? Copy the address and paste it into Safari.
CP_SETTINGS_NOTE: "Settings" means the Settings app of the iPad (grey gear icon on the Home Screen) - not a setting inside Safari.
CP_AND_I: Download the certificate file below. Settings > Security (or Security & privacy) > Encryption & credentials > Install a certificate > CA certificate, then pick the file. The path differs a little by phone.
CP_WIN_I: Download the certificate file below and double-click it > Install Certificate > Local Machine (or Current User) > "Place all certificates in the following store" > Browse > "Trusted Root Certification Authorities" > Finish.
CP_MAC_I: Download the certificate file below and double-click it (it opens Keychain Access). Find "OpenCue Local CA", double-click it > Trust > "When using this certificate": Always Trust.
CP_UN_IOS: Settings app > General > VPN & Device Management > under "Configuration Profile" tap "OpenCue" > Remove Profile > enter the passcode. (On some iOS versions the entry is called "Profiles".)
CP_UN_AND: Remove: Settings > Security > Encryption & credentials > User credentials (or Trusted credentials > User) > tap "OpenCue Local CA" > Remove.
CP_UN_WIN: Remove: press Win+R, type certmgr.msc > Trusted Root Certification Authorities > Certificates > right-click "OpenCue Local CA" > Delete.
CP_UN_MAC: Remove: Keychain Access > Certificates > select "OpenCue Local CA" > File > Delete (or right-click > Delete).
CP_UN_AFTER: Afterwards the secure page (https) shows the warning again and the offline page no longer works. Nothing else changes - OpenCue itself stays as it is.
CERT_SAFARI: Important: open the address in Safari.
PATCH_TRUNCATED_TOAST: Only {n} of {wanted} fixtures fit into universe {u} from channel {start}. The others were not created.
PATCH_OUT_OF_RANGE_TOAST: The fixture needs {ch} channels and would not fit from channel {start} (limit 512). The address was not changed.
FX_ADD_CLASH_WARN: Note: channels {from}-{to} in universe {univ} are already used by {n} fixture(s) ({names}). Overlapping is allowed, but both will react to the same values.
PATCH_SPILLED_TOAST: {count} fixtures created - the last ones continue in universe {to} (universe {from} was full).
FXLV_VIEW_DELETE_BODY: Really delete the area “{name}”? The fixtures keep their positions.
FS_PICK_NONE: Choose a drive, then open folders until you reach the one you want.
FS_DELETE_BODY: Really delete the file “{name}”? This cannot be undone.
FS_DELETE_BODY_DIR: Really delete the folder “{name}” with everything in it? This cannot be undone.
FS_ERR_EXISTS: There is already something with that name.
FS_ERR_OUTSIDE: This location is outside the OpenCue folder.
FS_ERR_NOT_FOUND: Not found - maybe it was moved or deleted.
FS_ERR_ROOT: The OpenCue folder itself cannot be changed here.
DMXIN_ANNOUNCE_HINT: OpenCue answers the search of other devices and shows up in their list of Art-Net devices (desks, visualisers, Art-Net tools) - so they can pick it as a target without typing the IP address.
DMXIN_FW_OK: Windows firewall: a rule for OpenCue exists - Art-Net and sACN get through.
DMXIN_FW_NONE: Windows firewall: there is no rule for OpenCue yet - incoming Art-Net and sACN packets may be blocked.
VOICE_MODEL_MISSING: The voice model (41 MB) is not installed yet. OpenCue loads it once from the internet - until then the wake word does not work.
VOICE_MODEL_ERROR: The download failed ({error}). Check the internet connection and try again.
